tools.description: Ask the user a concise question when you need confirmation, a choice, or missing information before proceeding. An answer item with empty selected and no custom means the user skipped that question: continue without it, do not ask it again, and do not treat the skip as permission.

questions.description: Questions to ask the user before continuing.

header.description: Optional short heading for the question, such as "Confirm" or "Choose Mode".

options.description: Optional choices to show the user. If you recommend one, put it first and append "(Recommended)" to that label.

description.description: One sentence explaining the tradeoff or impact.

multi_select.description: Whether the user may select more than one option. Defaults to false.

tools.name: bash
tools.description: Execute a bash command (`bash -c`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh shell; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Managed `$DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. An unset variable expands to an empty string, so guard variables in such paths with `${VAR:?}`. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "npm install" → "Install package dependencies".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

name.description: New branch name, also used as the checkout directory: a few lowercase words joined by hyphens that describe the task, such as fix-login-retry. Omit to generate a unique name.

from.description: Local commit, branch, or tag to start from. Defaults to HEAD; no fetch is performed.

tools.name: glob
tools.description: Find files, not directories, whose paths match a glob pattern, including hidden and ignored files. Returns up to 100 paths in modification-time order; a larger result keeps the first paths and reports where the complete list was saved.

rrule.description: Supported RFC 5545 subset: one DTSTART line, a newline, and one RRULE line. DTSTART ends in Z for UTC or carries TZID with an IANA time zone; a fixed offset such as UTC+5 is Etc/GMT-5, with the sign reversed. DTSTART must name an existing local time. A TZID rule keeps local clock time across daylight-saving changes; generated nonexistent local times are skipped, and repeated ones occur once, at the earlier instant. DTSTART may be in the past; delivery starts with the first occurrence after creation. A one-time delivery is RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=1. No SECONDLY; BYSECOND takes one value. COUNT is at most 1000; use UNTIL for longer rules. MINUTELY and HOURLY accept no BY parts, so select clock times with DAILY or WEEKLY plus BYHOUR and BYMINUTE. BYMONTHDAY and ordinal BYDAY require MONTHLY or YEARLY; BYYEARDAY and BYWEEKNO require YEARLY. Ordinal BYDAY cannot combine with BYWEEKNO. Each FREQ period allows at most 10080 candidates before BYSETPOS, which accepts at most 31 values. UNTIL is a UTC instant ending in Z. Example: "DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Singapore:20260901T080000\nRRULE:FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR;BYSETPOS=-1"

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

"""A2A 出站专用契约（2026-11-10 需求变更）。

本服务只做 A2A Client：不发布 Agent Card、不暴露 JSON-RPC 入站端点。
本文件固定这条边界，防止后续误把入站路由加回来。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import httpx

from tests.conftest import auth_headers, register_user

_EXPECTED_A2A_INFO = {
    "enabled": False,
    "card_url": "",
    "jsonrpc_url": "",
    "auth_type": "none",
    "card_security": "none",
}


async def test_system_info_reports_no_a2a_inbound(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    registered = await register_user(client)
    response = await client.get(
        "/api/v1/system/info", headers=auth_headers(registered["access_token"])
    )
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.json()["a2a"] == _EXPECTED_A2A_INFO


async def test_a2a_inbound_routes_not_registered(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    """well-known Agent Card 与 JSON-RPC 端点都不应存在。"""
    for path in ("/a2a/.well-known/agent-card.json", "/.well-known/agent-card.json"):
        response = await client.get(path)
        assert response.status_code == 404, f"{path} 不应注册入站路由"

    response = await client.post(
        "/a2a",
        json={"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": "req-1", "method": "message/send", "params": {}},
    )
    assert response.status_code == 404

async def test_system_scope_upload_requires_admin(
    client: httpx.AsyncClient,
    auth: dict[str, str],
    admin_auth: dict[str, str],
    fake_storage: Any,
    fake_embedding: Any,
) -> None:
    forbidden = await _upload(
        client, auth, filename="notice.md", content="# 公告\n\n内容".encode(), scope="system"
    )
    assert forbidden.status_code == 403
    assert forbidden.json()["error"]["code"] == "forbidden"

    allowed = await _upload(
        client, admin_auth, filename="notice.md", content="# 公告\n\n内容".encode(), scope="system"
    )
    assert allowed.status_code == 201, allowed.text
    assert allowed.json()["owner"] is None


async def test_admin_owner_scope_all_lists_every_document(
    client: httpx.AsyncClient, admin_auth: dict[str, str], seeded_docs: dict
) -> None:
    response = await client.get(f"{DOCUMENTS_URL}?owner_scope=all", headers=admin_auth)

    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
    payload = response.json()
    assert len(payload["items"]) == 3
    by_id = {item["id"]: item for item in payload["items"]}
    assert by_id[str(seeded_docs["other"].id)]["owner"] == {
        "id": str(seeded_docs["other_user"].id),
        "display_name": "其他用户",
    }
    assert by_id[str(seeded_docs["system"].id)]["owner"] is None


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ 能力开关
async def test_knowledge_disabled_returns_403_on_every_endpoint(
    client: httpx.AsyncClient,
    auth: dict[str, str],
    fake_storage: Any,
    fake_embedding: Any,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    document_id = uuid.uuid4()
    monkeypatch.setenv("KNOWLEDGE_ENABLED", "false")
    reset_settings_cache()
    try:
        responses = await asyncio.gather(
            _upload(client, auth, filename="disabled.md", content=b"# x\n\ny"),
            client.get(DOCUMENTS_URL, headers=auth),
            client.get(f"{DOCUMENTS_URL}/{document_id}", headers=auth),
            client.delete(f"{DOCUMENTS_URL}/{document_id}", headers=auth),
            client.post(f"{DOCUMENTS_URL}/{document_id}/retry", headers=auth),
            client.post(SEARCH_URL, json={"query": "退货"}, headers=auth),
            client.post(REBUILD_URL, json={"scope": "all"}, headers=auth),
        )
    finally:
        reset_settings_cache()

    assert len(responses) == 7
    for response in responses:
        assert response.status_code == 403, response.text
        assert response.json()["error"]["code"] == "capability_disabled"

    client: httpx.AsyncClient, auth: dict[str, str], monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:

        "app.modules.knowledge.service.get_embedding_provider",
        lambda: _BrokenEmbeddingProvider(),

**Interfaces:**
- Produces: `GET /api/v1/runs/{run_id}/stream?after_seq=<int:0>` → `text/event-stream`
- Consumes: `service.stream_run_events(run_id, after_seq=..., max_replay=1000)`、`service.get_run(db, user, run_id)`（所有权）、`format_sse`
- Errors: 401 未登录；404 非本人/不存在；400 `replay_too_large`（回放 > 1000 条，提示用分页接口）；run 已终态且无事件时返回 200 空流后立即关闭（不引入额外错误码）

- [ ] **Step 1: 写失败测试**（用 `httpx.ASGITransport` 会缓冲 SSE，实时部分用服务层 `collect_run_events_live` 或直接消费生成器）：
  - 已完成的 run：`GET .../stream?after_seq=0` 依次收到已落库事件，终态后流结束；
  - `after_seq` 跳过前 N 条；
  - 他人 run：404；未登录：401；
  - 回放 > 1000：400 `replay_too_large`；
  - `interrupted` run：回放后保持连接，审批恢复后继续收到事件（可用服务层测试）。
- [ ] **Step 2: 运行测试确认失败**。
- [ ] **Step 3: 实现路由**：
  - `@router.get("/runs/{run_id}/stream", response_class=StreamingResponse, responses=_SSE_RESPONSES)`
  - 路由内先 `await service.get_run(db, user, run_id)` 做所有权；再 `await service.ensure_replay_size(db, run_id, after_seq, max_replay=1000)`；
  - `StreamingResponse(service.stream_run_events(run_id, after_seq=after_seq), media_type="text/event-stream", headers={...})`；
  - 响应头 `X-Run-ID`、`X-Request-ID`；不重复 `_SSE_HEADERS` 之外的 buffer 头。
- [ ] **Step 4: 实现服务**：`ensure_replay_size` 用 `select(count())` 或 `limit(max_replay+1)`；`stream_run_events` 透传 `max_replay`（生成器内部仍按 seq 回放，超限已在路由拦截）。
- [ ] **Step 5: 补 OpenAPI 描述**（§7.8/§10.2 口径：回放 + 实时、终态关闭、15s 心跳、单实例）。
- [ ] **Step 6: 验证**：新测试 + `pytest -q` + ruff。

**Acceptance:** 前端可用 `fetch-event-source` 带 Bearer 从 `lastSeq` 续流；非本人不可见；旧 `POST /chat/stream` 行为不变。

   这是全局约束中明确写出的一条，代码用宽 `try/except` + warning 实现，方向正确；但没有任何测试模拟 `write_audit`/独立会话抛错并断言 403 信封仍完整返回。建议加一个测试 monkeypatch `app.core.deps.write_audit` 抛 `RuntimeError`（或让 `get_session_factory` 抛错），断言响应仍为 403 `forbidden` + `details.required_role`，避免今后重构时把这条保证悄悄弄丢。

3. **[app/core/deps.py:70-74](app/core/deps.py#L70-L74)：审计范围比“拒绝写操作”宽，包含只读管理员端点的拒绝访问。**
   `require_admin` 同时被 `GET /admin/audit-logs`、`GET /admin/secrets` 等读端点使用，因此普通用户每次被这些读接口拒绝也会写一条审计。设计文档的措辞是“所有被拒绝的**写操作**”；当前行为可视为有意的单点收益（brief Step 4 也允许走 `require_admin` 失败路径），但副作用是任意已登录非管理员可通过反复请求管理读接口持续制造审计行（写放大/日志噪音）。建议至少显式确认接受，或按 `request.method in {"POST","PUT","PATCH","DELETE"}` 过滤后再审计，更贴近设计措辞。

4. **[tests/integration/test_rbac.py:74-90](tests/integration/test_rbac.py#L74-L90)：403 用例在失败态可能触发真实网络请求。**
   参数化用例中的 `agents-create` 没有注册 mock transport；如果门禁回归，`POST /agents` 会真的去请求 `http://a2a.test` 拉 Card（报告的 RED 证据正是走了 Card 拉取并得到 422）。当前 GREEN 状态下不会发网络请求，但“零网络测试”在失败态会被破坏。建议在该测试里先 `_register_fake()`（或用 autouse fixture 注册），让门禁回归时也只会在 mock 上失败。

5. **[tests/integration/test_rbac.py:201-205](tests/integration/test_rbac.py#L201-L205)：只覆盖了缺 token 的 401，未覆盖非法 token 的 401。**
   约束同时要求“missing/invalid token → 401”。`get_current_user` 未动，行为理论上没问题，但写端点上的 invalid token 没有直接断言。补一个 `Authorization: Bearer garbage` 用例即可。

6. **[app/core/deps.py:43-57](app/core/deps.py#L43-L57)：`resource_id` 只记录 endpoint path，未记录目标 agent/task 的 UUID。**
   这满足“action/resource/actor”的最低口径，`resource_type="endpoint"` 也自洽；但审计排查时丢失了“具体对哪个 Agent/任务发起写操作”的信息。`request.path_params` 在依赖中已可用，可把目标 id 放进 `detail`（例如 `detail.target_id`），`resource_id` 仍保留路径，成本很低。

**Reasoning:** 端点收紧矩阵、403 信封、独立会话拒绝审计、读/预览保留与 401 行为均与 brief 和全局约束一致，代码结构清晰且测试覆盖了绝大多数关键路径；剩余问题都是测试完备性与审计范围上的 Minor 改进，没有发现功能或安全上的实质缺陷。

1. **[tests/integration/test_rbac.py:153-178](tests/integration/test_rbac.py#L153-L178) / [tests/integration/test_tasks.py:602-646](tests/integration/test_tasks.py#L602-L646)：管理员任务动作只证明了“非 403（业务 404）”，未证明成功。**
   brief 的 Step 1 写的是“管理员同操作成功”。目前 resume/authorize/reject 的成功路径由既有 `test_tasks.py` 用 `admin_headers` 覆盖，但 **cancel 的成功路径没有任何 HTTP 级验证**——`test_cancel_working_task_resolves_headers` 直接调用 `tasks_service.cancel_task_action(session, user, task.id)`，用普通用户绕过路由门禁。虽然 router 改动与其它动作同构、风险低，但这是本次唯一没有被 HTTP 级正向测试覆盖的动作。建议在 `test_rbac.py` 用落库的 `working` 任务 + `admin_auth` 调 `POST /tasks/{id}/cancel` 并断言 200/`canceled`；顺带可把 resume/authorize/reject 也改成同等强度的成功断言。

2. **[app/core/deps.py:41-67](app/core/deps.py#L41-L67)：缺少“审计失败不影响 403”的测试。**
   这是全局约束中明确写出的一条，代码用宽 `try/except` + warning 实现，方向正确；但没有任何测试模拟 `write_audit`/独立会话抛错并断言 403 信封仍完整返回。建议加一个测试 monkeypatch `app.core.deps.write_audit` 抛 `RuntimeError`（或让 `get_session_factory` 抛错），断言响应仍为 403 `forbidden` + `details.required_role`，避免今后重构时把这条保证悄悄弄丢。

3. **[app/core/deps.py:70-74](app/core/deps.py#L70-L74)：审计范围比“拒绝写操作”宽，包含只读管理员端点的拒绝访问。**
   `require_admin` 同时被 `GET /admin/audit-logs`、`GET /admin/secrets` 等读端点使用，因此普通用户每次被这些读接口拒绝也会写一条审计。设计文档的措辞是“所有被拒绝的**写操作**”；当前行为可视为有意的单点收益（brief Step 4 也允许走 `require_admin` 失败路径），但副作用是任意已登录非管理员可通过反复请求管理读接口持续制造审计行（写放大/日志噪音）。建议至少显式确认接受，或按 `request.method in {"POST","PUT","PATCH","DELETE"}` 过滤后再审计，更贴近设计措辞。

4. **[tests/integration/test_rbac.py:74-90](tests/integration/test_rbac.py#L74-L90)：403 用例在失败态可能触发真实网络请求。**
   参数化用例中的 `agents-create` 没有注册 mock transport；如果门禁回归，`POST /agents` 会真的去请求 `http://a2a.test` 拉 Card（报告的 RED 证据正是走了 Card 拉取并得到 422）。当前 GREEN 状态下不会发网络请求，但“零网络测试”在失败态会被破坏。建议在该测试里先 `_register_fake()`（或用 autouse fixture 注册），让门禁回归时也只会在 mock 上失败。

5. **[tests/integration/test_rbac.py:201-205](tests/integration/test_rbac.py#L201-L205)：只覆盖了缺 token 的 401，未覆盖非法 token 的 401。**
   约束同时要求“missing/invalid token → 401”。`get_current_user` 未动，行为理论上没问题，但写端点上的 invalid token 没有直接断言。补一个 `Authorization: Bearer garbage` 用例即可。

6. **[app/core/deps.py:43-57](app/core/deps.py#L43-L57)：`resource_id` 只记录 endpoint path，未记录目标 agent/task 的 UUID。**
   这满足“action/resource/actor”的最低口径，`resource_type="endpoint"` 也自洽；但审计排查时丢失了“具体对哪个 Agent/任务发起写操作”的信息。`request.path_params` 在依赖中已可用，可把目标 id 放进 `detail`（例如 `detail.target_id`），`resource_id` 仍保留路径，成本很低。

### Assessment

**Task quality:** Approved

**Reasoning:** 端点收紧矩阵、403 信封、独立会话拒绝审计、读/预览保留与 401 行为均与 brief 和全局约束一致，代码结构清晰且测试覆盖了绝大多数关键路径；剩余问题都是测试完备性与审计范围上的 Minor 改进，没有发现功能或安全上的实质缺陷。
